authenticated_quality_rule: quality_results independently requires the exact nine formal tier names and successful complete backend, formal, frontend, database and policy groups, including both policy-tests and consumer-tests, even when optional raw execution evidence is absent; admission binds details but cannot reduce these inventories

raw_optional_external_skip.rule: Only the exact top-level skip with the existing absent-input reason, explicit frozen compiled selector membership and complete frozen-plan marker sequence is structurally accepted. Every START/END pair must match its frozen entry/phase and END must have integer-zero exit; missing, duplicate, dangling, contradictory or unknown entry evidence rejects. SQLite producer and selected dialect pairs remain required: dialect START overrides run with the exact known test/sqlite selector while END retains the original frozen selector. No required leaf, other skip, failure, duplicate event, wildcard router selector or missing context is exempt. This is fixed inspector policy, not an admission-configurable allowlist.
